limits: Static implementation review does not certify the not-yet-terminal remaining run or actual future service release.
Production finalizer/gate must independently validate frozen authority and stage ACKs; focused archive tests mock this dependency.
No actual ZIP, process probe, service/model request, raw response read or restore performed in this review.
All report writers must be quiet before the eventual archive; code checks cannot eliminate deliberate post-check filesystem races.
Narrow duplicate-ignore is eligible only for actual verified member paths after successful final archive verification; this review does not approve hiding unique data, papers or audit JSON.
